individualTimeline: Episode 1, "O Começo": Adrian first appears as the unnamed first-person narrator in the historical prose.
Early 2026: Adrian begins planning the organization that becomes Kairos Esports.
Early 2026: Adrian establishes Kairos Esports as its founder and owner.
2026: Adrian personally participates in recruiting and developing the original League of Legends program.
Late October 2026: Adrian oversees the early construction of the Counter-Strike division.
Episodes 30-35: Adrian personally evaluates Caleb Mercer, rejects sponsorship proposals that conflict with Kairos philosophy, and begins personally recruiting Owen Fletcher.
Late October 2026: Adrian travels to Mackenzie, British Columbia, and meets Owen Fletcher for the first time.
Episodes 36-38: Adrian meets Owen's grandfather and offers Owen a non-binding three-week evaluation invitation.
Episode 39: Adrian signs Caleb as Kairos's first Counter-Strike player and appoints him Founding Captain.
Episodes 41-42: Adrian begins evaluating Cameron Ruiz and reviews Emiliano Navarro's scouting report.
Episodes 43-53: Adrian oversees Owen Fletcher's and Emiliano Navarro's evaluations, establishes people-first recruiting, and begins background verification for future recruits.
Episode 53: Adrian delays further recruitment until cultural fit is confirmed.
Episode 54: Adrian develops Project Casa Arthur as a conditional future support plan without beginning construction or relocation.
Episodes 55-56: Adrian puts a restricted food-service proposal to a full Kairos community vote and authorizes invitations and negotiations after approval.
February 2027: Kairos is scheduled to begin official League, NACL, and Counter-Strike competition.
